# API reference

<!-- Generated by doc/tools/build.mjs from doc/tools/endpoints.mjs — edit those, not this file. -->

114 endpoints. Every callable is `POST /api/<name>` with body `{ "data": { … } }`; success is `200 { "result": … }`, failure is `{ "error": { "status", "message" } }`. See [architecture.md](architecture.md#the-callable-contract) for the contract, identity rules and error codes.

**Auth column:** *Public* needs no token. Everything else resolves the caller from the Bearer token (or, without one and with `AUTH_STRICT=false`, from `username` / `callerUsername` in the body). Role names are the checks the handler performs on top of that.

## Health & discovery

Plain GET routes outside the callable contract. No auth.

| Endpoint | Auth | Purpose |
|---|---|---|
| [`health`](#health) | Public — no token | Liveness + database check. |
| [`__callables`](#__callables) | Public — no token | Every callable name this deployment serves. |

### health

`GET /health` · **Public — no token**

Liveness + database check.

**Returns:** `{ ok, db: "up" | "down", env }` — 503 when MySQL is unreachable.

### __callables

`GET /api/__callables` · **Public — no token**

Every callable name this deployment serves.

**Returns:** `{ callables: string[] }` (sorted).

**Notes:** Use it to confirm a deploy exposes what the client calls.

## Auth

Sign-in, sign-up and account creation. `login` and `signup` return a JWT that the collection stores in `{{authToken}}` automatically.

| Endpoint | Auth | Purpose |
|---|---|---|
| [`login`](#login) | Public — no token | Sign in and receive a JWT. |
| [`signup`](#signup) | Public — no token | Self sign-up — creates a `user` pending approval. |
| [`register`](#register) | admin · bootlegar · organization | Admin / bootlegar / organization creates another account. |
| [`verifyEmail`](#verifyemail) | Public — no token | Confirm an email address from the signup link. |
| [`forgotPassword`](#forgotpassword) | Public — no token | Email a password-reset link. |
| [`resetPassword`](#resetpassword) | Public — no token | Set a new password with a reset token. |

### login

`POST /api/login` · **Public — no token**

Sign in and receive a JWT.

**Required:** `username`, `password`

```json
{
  "data": {
    "username": "{{username}}",
    "password": "{{password}}"
  }
}
```

**Returns:** The user record (`username`, `role`, `credits`, `allowedApps`, `resolution`, …) plus `capabilities`, `carpenterAccount` and `token`.

**Notes:** Rate limited: 30 attempts / 15 min per IP. Errors: `not-found` (unknown user), `unauthenticated` (wrong password).

### signup

`POST /api/signup` · **Public — no token**

Self sign-up — creates a `user` pending approval.

**Required:** `username`, `password`

```json
{
  "data": {
    "username": "newuser",
    "password": "a-strong-password",
    "email": "newuser@example.com"
  }
}
```

**Returns:** The new user record plus `token`, like `login`.

**Notes:** Account starts `accountStatus: "pending_approval"` with `DEFAULT_APPS`. Sends a verification email when SMTP is configured. Rate limited like `login`. In Postman the returned token is *not* stored — the collection stays signed in as `{{username}}`.

### register

`POST /api/register` · **admin · bootlegar · organization**

Admin / bootlegar / organization creates another account.

**Required:** `username`, `password`

```json
{
  "data": {
    "callerUsername": "{{username}}",
    "username": "dealer_one",
    "password": "a-strong-password",
    "role": "user",
    "displayName": "Dealer One",
    "initialCredits": 20,
    "resolution": "2K",
    "allowedApps": [
      "CARPENTER"
    ],
    "organizationId": null
  }
}
```

**Returns:** The created user (`username`, `role`, `credits`, `allowedApps`, `resolution`, `organizationId`, `capabilities`, …).

**Notes:** An organization always creates `org_user` members of itself. A bootlegar pays `initialCredits` from its own balance. Carpenter onboarding: see docs/carpenter-onboarding.md (Manufacturer = `organization`, Dealer Pro = `user`, Sponsored dealer = `org_user` + `organizationId`).

### verifyEmail

`POST /api/verifyEmail` · **Public — no token**

Confirm an email address from the signup link.

**Required:** `username`, `token`

```json
{
  "data": {
    "username": "newuser",
    "token": "<token from the email link>"
  }
}
```

**Returns:** `{ success, message }`.

### forgotPassword

`POST /api/forgotPassword` · **Public — no token**

Email a password-reset link.

**Required:** `username`

```json
{
  "data": {
    "username": "{{username}}"
  }
}
```

**Returns:** `{ success, message }`.

**Notes:** Needs SMTP configured. Rate limited.

### resetPassword

`POST /api/resetPassword` · **Public — no token**

Set a new password with a reset token.

**Required:** `username`, `token`, `newPassword`

```json
{
  "data": {
    "username": "{{username}}",
    "token": "<token from the email link>",
    "newPassword": "a-new-password"
  }
}
```

**Returns:** `{ success, message }`.

**Notes:** Errors: `permission-denied` for an invalid or expired token. Rate limited.

## Users & credits

Profiles, account management and credit balances.

| Endpoint | Auth | Purpose |
|---|---|---|
| [`getCurrentUser`](#getcurrentuser) | Signed in | The signed-in user, with the org's credit pool for org members. |
| [`getUsers`](#getusers) | admin · bootlegar · organization | List users — all for an admin, own creations for a bootlegar / organization. |
| [`updateUser`](#updateuser) | admin · bootlegar · organization | Change another user's role, credits, apps, resolution or password. |
| [`deleteUser`](#deleteuser) | admin · bootlegar · organization | Delete a user (their generation history is kept). |
| [`updateUserProfile`](#updateuserprofile) | Signed in | Own display name, share-message preset and (organization) logo. |
| [`getUserCredits`](#getusercredits) | Signed in | Current balance (an org member sees the org's pool). |
| [`deductCredits`](#deductcredits) | Signed in | Spend credits for work done outside the AI routes. |
| [`addCredits`](#addcredits) | admin · bootlegar | Grant credits (admin mints; bootlegar transfers its own). |
| [`setUserCredits`](#setusercredits) | admin only | Set an exact balance. |

### getCurrentUser

`POST /api/getCurrentUser` · **Signed in**

The signed-in user, with the org's credit pool for org members.

```json
{
  "data": {
    "username": "{{username}}"
  }
}
```

**Returns:** User record + `capabilities` + `carpenterAccount`.

### getUsers

`POST /api/getUsers` · **admin · bootlegar · organization**

List users — all for an admin, own creations for a bootlegar / organization.

```json
{
  "data": {
    "callerUsername": "{{username}}"
  }
}
```

**Returns:** Array of users (passwords never included).

### updateUser

`POST /api/updateUser` · **admin · bootlegar · organization**

Change another user's role, credits, apps, resolution or password.

**Required:** `targetUsername`

```json
{
  "data": {
    "callerUsername": "{{username}}",
    "targetUsername": "{{targetUsername}}",
    "updates": {
      "credits": 50,
      "resolution": "2K",
      "allowedApps": [
        "CARPENTER",
        "QR_GEN_PRO"
      ]
    }
  }
}
```

**Returns:** `{ success }`.

**Notes:** Allowed keys: `role`, `credits`, `allowedApps`, `resolution` (`1K` | `2K` | `4K`), `password`. Bootlegars / organizations may only touch accounts they created and never change roles; bootlegars also cannot change apps or resolution.

### deleteUser

`POST /api/deleteUser` · **admin · bootlegar · organization**

Delete a user (their generation history is kept).

**Required:** `targetUsername`

```json
{
  "data": {
    "callerUsername": "{{username}}",
    "targetUsername": "{{targetUsername}}"
  }
}
```

**Returns:** `{ success }`.

**Notes:** The super admin cannot be deleted.

### updateUserProfile

`POST /api/updateUserProfile` · **Signed in**

Own display name, share-message preset and (organization) logo.

```json
{
  "data": {
    "username": "{{username}}",
    "displayName": "Suru Laminates",
    "shareMessagePreset": "Here is your render from Suru Studio",
    "logoBase64": "{{sampleImageBase64}}",
    "logoMimeType": "image/png"
  }
}
```

**Returns:** The updated profile fields.

**Notes:** Only organizations and admins can set a logo.

### getUserCredits

`POST /api/getUserCredits` · **Signed in**

Current balance (an org member sees the org's pool).

```json
{
  "data": {
    "username": "{{username}}"
  }
}
```

**Returns:** `{ credits }`.

### deductCredits

`POST /api/deductCredits` · **Signed in**

Spend credits for work done outside the AI routes.

**Required:** `username`, `amount`

```json
{
  "data": {
    "username": "{{username}}",
    "amount": 1
  }
}
```

**Returns:** `{ success }` — `failed-precondition` when the balance is too low.

### addCredits

`POST /api/addCredits` · **admin · bootlegar**

Grant credits (admin mints; bootlegar transfers its own).

**Required:** `targetUsername`, `amount`

```json
{
  "data": {
    "callerUsername": "{{username}}",
    "targetUsername": "{{targetUsername}}",
    "amount": 10
  }
}
```

**Returns:** `{ success, newCredits }`.

**Notes:** A bootlegar may only top up accounts it created.

### setUserCredits

`POST /api/setUserCredits` · **admin only**

Set an exact balance.

**Required:** `targetUsername`, `amount`

```json
{
  "data": {
    "callerUsername": "{{username}}",
    "targetUsername": "{{targetUsername}}",
    "amount": 100
  }
}
```

**Returns:** `{ success, credits }`.

## AI generation

Every generate* call prices the account's resolution, spends credits, calls the configured image provider (Gemini or OpenAI), stores the render and saves a generation record — refunding on any failure. **Each successful call costs real credits and provider spend.** Rate limited: 20 / minute per IP. Images travel as base64 (no data: prefix) with a mimeType; catalog images can be sent as `{ "imageId": "<product image id>" }` instead.

| Endpoint | Auth | Purpose |
|---|---|---|
| [`generateSuruShot`](#generatesurushot) | Signed in | Product photography from one product photo. |
| [`generateTileMaster`](#generatetilemaster) | Signed in | Tile the mapped surfaces of the user's own room photo. |
| [`generateCarpenter`](#generatecarpenter) | Signed in | Laminate on furniture — preset room or the user's own photo. |
| [`generateMarbleX`](#generatemarblex) | Signed in | Marble slab on floor / walls, preset room or own photo. |
| [`generateHardware`](#generatehardware) | Signed in | Door hardware installed on a door, optionally in a reference scene. |
| [`generateJigsaw`](#generatejigsaw) | Signed in | Product studio shot (Jigsaw AI; BathExpert with tool=BATH_EXPERT). |
| [`generateGodPosters`](#generategodposters) | Signed in | Devotional poster art. |
| [`generateCreativeBrief`](#generatecreativebrief) | Signed in | Text-only prompt helper ("enhance my prompt") — no credits. |

### generateSuruShot

`POST /api/generateSuruShot` · **Signed in**

Product photography from one product photo.

**Required:** `username`, `imageBase64`

```json
{
  "data": {
    "username": "{{username}}",
    "imageBase64": "{{sampleImageBase64}}",
    "imageMimeType": "image/png",
    "prompt": "On a marble counter, soft window light",
    "aspectRatio": "1:1"
  }
}
```

**Returns:** `{ success, imageUrl, generationId }` — `imageUrl` is a data URL of the render.

### generateTileMaster

`POST /api/generateTileMaster` · **Signed in**

Tile the mapped surfaces of the user's own room photo.

**Required:** `username`, `imageBase64`, `originalImageBase64`

```json
{
  "data": {
    "username": "{{username}}",
    "originalImageBase64": "{{sampleImageBase64}}",
    "originalImageMimeType": "image/png",
    "imageBase64": "{{sampleImageBase64}}",
    "imageMimeType": "image/png",
    "tileImages": [
      {
        "imageId": "{{imageId}}"
      }
    ],
    "surfaces": [
      {
        "label": "Floor",
        "plane": "floor",
        "tileSize": "600x600",
        "tileImageIds": [
          1
        ],
        "cols": 8,
        "rows": 6,
        "corners": [
          {
            "x": 0.1,
            "y": 0.6
          },
          {
            "x": 0.9,
            "y": 0.6
          },
          {
            "x": 1,
            "y": 1
          },
          {
            "x": 0,
            "y": 1
          }
        ]
      }
    ],
    "tileSize": "600x600",
    "groutColor": "#d9d9d9",
    "groutThicknessMm": 2,
    "harmonizeDecor": false,
    "creativeMode": false,
    "aspectRatio": "16:9",
    "scene": {
      "name": "Living room"
    }
  }
}
```

**Returns:** `{ success, imageUrl, generationId }`.

**Notes:** Image order is fixed: [original photo, surfaces-only tile layer (`imageBase64`), ...tileImages]. `tileImageIds` on a surface are 1-based positions in `tileImages`.

### generateCarpenter

`POST /api/generateCarpenter` · **Signed in**

Laminate on furniture — preset room or the user's own photo.

**Required:** `username`, `laminateBase64 or laminateImageId`

```json
{
  "data": {
    "username": "{{username}}",
    "laminateBase64": "{{sampleImageBase64}}",
    "laminateMimeType": "image/png",
    "accentLaminateBase64": null,
    "accentLaminateMimeType": null,
    "sceneId": "{{sceneId}}",
    "sceneImageBase64": null,
    "sceneImageMimeType": null,
    "scene": {
      "name": "Modern wardrobe",
      "prompt": "Floor-to-ceiling wardrobe, handleless shutters"
    },
    "accentRegions": [],
    "decorateRoom": false,
    "creativeMode": false,
    "prompt": "",
    "aspectRatio": "4:3"
  }
}
```

**Returns:** `{ success, imageUrl, generationId, … }` plus Carpenter branding fields for sponsored dealers.

**Notes:** Scene: `sceneId` renders onto a library scene (see Carpenter scenes) — its image is read server-side and its ratio is the default `aspectRatio`; `sceneImageBase64` renders onto an uploaded room photo and wins over `sceneId`; with neither, `scene.name` / `scene.prompt` describe a room to invent. Use `laminateImageId` / `accentLaminateImageId` to render a catalog laminate by product-image id. `accentRegions` (0–1 boxes `{x,y,w,h}`) apply to any real photo (upload or library scene); `decorateRoom` only to uploads.

### generateMarbleX

`POST /api/generateMarbleX` · **Signed in**

Marble slab on floor / walls, preset room or own photo.

**Required:** `username`, `marbleBase64`

```json
{
  "data": {
    "username": "{{username}}",
    "marbleBase64": "{{sampleImageBase64}}",
    "marbleMimeType": "image/png",
    "sceneImageBase64": null,
    "sceneImageMimeType": null,
    "target": "floor",
    "flow": "bookmatch",
    "scene": {
      "name": "Lobby"
    },
    "prompt": "",
    "creativeMode": false,
    "aspectRatio": "16:9"
  }
}
```

**Returns:** `{ success, imageUrl, generationId }`.

**Notes:** `target`: `floor` | `walls` | `both`.

### generateHardware

`POST /api/generateHardware` · **Signed in**

Door hardware installed on a door, optionally in a reference scene.

**Required:** `username`, `imageBase64`

```json
{
  "data": {
    "username": "{{username}}",
    "imageBase64": "{{sampleImageBase64}}",
    "imageMimeType": "image/png",
    "referenceImageBase64": null,
    "referenceImageMimeType": null,
    "scene": {
      "name": "Modern door"
    },
    "prompt": "",
    "creativeMode": false,
    "aspectRatio": "3:4"
  }
}
```

**Returns:** `{ success, imageUrl, generationId }`.

### generateJigsaw

`POST /api/generateJigsaw` · **Signed in**

Product studio shot (Jigsaw AI; BathExpert with tool=BATH_EXPERT).

**Required:** `username`, `imageBase64`

```json
{
  "data": {
    "username": "{{username}}",
    "imageBase64": "{{sampleImageBase64}}",
    "imageMimeType": "image/png",
    "tool": "JIGSAW",
    "productId": "Basin mixer",

      "shadows": "Soft"

      "type": "Preset",
      "preset": "Minimal bathroom",
      "customPrompt": ""
    },
    "decorativeElements": true
  }
}
```

**Returns:** `{ success, imageUrl, generationId }`.

### generateGodPosters

`POST /api/generateGodPosters` · **Signed in**

Devotional poster art.

**Required:** `username`

```json
{
  "data": {
    "username": "{{username}}",
    "deityCategory": "Ganesha",
    "customDeity": "",
    "posterStyle": "Traditional",
    "blessingText": "Shubh Labh",
    "mantraText": "",
    "prompt": "",
    "imageBase64": null,
    "imageMimeType": null,
    "aspectRatio": "3:4"
  }
}
```

**Returns:** `{ success, imageUrl, generationId }`.

### generateCreativeBrief

`POST /api/generateCreativeBrief` · **Signed in**

Text-only prompt helper ("enhance my prompt") — no credits.

**Required:** `config`

```json
{
  "data": {
    "username": "{{username}}",
    "config": {
      "productId": "Basin mixer",
      "composition": {
        "cameraAngle": "Eye level",
        "aspectRatio": "1:1"
      },
      "atmosphere": {
        "lighting": "Soft",
        "shadows": "Soft"
      },
      "environment": {
        "type": "Preset",
        "preset": "Minimal bathroom"
      }
    }
  }
}
```

**Returns:** `{ text }` — a stock brief when no Gemini key is configured.

**Notes:** Always uses Gemini's text model. Rate limited like generations.

## Generations

Stored render records (what Files and the admin records view list).

| Endpoint | Auth | Purpose |
|---|---|---|
| [`saveGeneration`](#savegeneration) | Signed in | Save a record for an image the client produced itself. |
| [`getGenerations`](#getgenerations) | Signed in | Own records, or any user's when the caller is admin. |
| [`updateGenerationImage`](#updategenerationimage) | Signed in | Replace a record's image with a client-side composite. |
| [`deleteGeneration`](#deletegeneration) | admin only | Delete a generation record and its files. |

### saveGeneration

`POST /api/saveGeneration` · **Signed in**

Save a record for an image the client produced itself.

**Required:** `username`, `tool`, `imageUrl`

```json
{
  "data": {
    "username": "{{username}}",
    "tool": "CARPENTER",
    "imageUrl": "https://example.com/render.webp",
    "baseImageUrl": null,
    "prompt": "Saved from editor",
    "settings": "{\"kind\":\"render\"}",
    "creditsUsed": 0
  }
}
```

**Returns:** The saved generation record.

### getGenerations

`POST /api/getGenerations` · **Signed in**

Own records, or any user's when the caller is admin.

```json
{
  "data": {
    "callerUsername": "{{username}}",
    "filterUsername": "{{username}}",
    "limit": 50
  }
}
```

**Returns:** Array of generation records, newest first.

### updateGenerationImage

`POST /api/updateGenerationImage` · **Signed in**

Replace a record's image with a client-side composite.

**Required:** `generationId`, `base64Image`

```json
{
  "data": {
    "username": "{{username}}",
    "generationId": "{{generationId}}",
    "base64Image": "{{sampleImageBase64}}"
  }
}
```

**Returns:** `{ success, imageUrl }`.

### deleteGeneration

`POST /api/deleteGeneration` · **admin only**

Delete a generation record and its files.

**Required:** `generationId`

```json
{
  "data": {
    "callerUsername": "{{username}}",
    "generationId": "{{generationId}}"
  }
}
```

**Returns:** `{ success }`.

## Files (Drive)

Folders, files (generations), favorites, sharing and share links.

| Endpoint | Auth | Purpose |
|---|---|---|
| [`createFolder`](#createfolder) | Signed in | Create a folder (at Home when parentId is null). |
| [`getFileSystem`](#getfilesystem) | Signed in | Folders and files visible to the user in one folder, or a search. |
| [`renameResource`](#renameresource) | Signed in | Rename a file or folder (editor access). |
| [`moveFile`](#movefile) | Signed in | Move a file into a folder (null = Home). |
| [`moveFolder`](#movefolder) | Signed in | Move a folder under another (cycle-protected). |
| [`toggleFavorite`](#togglefavorite) | Signed in | Star / unstar a file or folder. |
| [`shareResource`](#shareresource) | Signed in | Share with users and/or set visibility (owner / admin role). |
| [`getResourceShares`](#getresourceshares) | Signed in | Who a resource is shared with (share dialog). |
| [`createShareLink`](#createsharelink) | Signed in | Create or rotate a public share link. |
| [`getSharedResource`](#getsharedresource) | Public — no token | Resolve a share-link token. |
| [`revokeShareLink`](#revokesharelink) | Signed in | Revoke a share link you created. |
| [`getActivity`](#getactivity) | Signed in | Activity for a resource, the caller's recent activity, or Carpenter share attempts. |
| [`deleteFolder`](#deletefolder) | Signed in | Delete a folder subtree; files move to Home unless deleteFiles. |

### createFolder

`POST /api/createFolder` · **Signed in**

Create a folder (at Home when parentId is null).

**Required:** `username`, `name`

```json
{
  "data": {
    "username": "{{username}}",
    "name": "Client renders",
    "parentId": null
  }
}
```

**Returns:** The folder, with `myRole: "owner"`.

### getFileSystem

`POST /api/getFileSystem` · **Signed in**

Folders and files visible to the user in one folder, or a search.

```json
{
  "data": {
    "username": "{{username}}",
    "parentId": null,
    "search": "",
    "favoritesOnly": false
  }
}
```

**Returns:** `{ folders, files }`.

### renameResource

`POST /api/renameResource` · **Signed in**

Rename a file or folder (editor access).

**Required:** `resourceId`, `resourceType`, `newName`

```json
{
  "data": {
    "username": "{{username}}",
    "resourceId": "{{folderId}}",
    "resourceType": "folder",
    "newName": "Renamed folder"
  }
}
```

**Returns:** `{ success }`.

### moveFile

`POST /api/moveFile` · **Signed in**

Move a file into a folder (null = Home).

**Required:** `fileId`

```json
{
  "data": {
    "username": "{{username}}",
    "fileId": "{{generationId}}",
    "folderId": "{{folderId}}"
  }
}
```

**Returns:** `{ success }`.

### moveFolder

`POST /api/moveFolder` · **Signed in**

Move a folder under another (cycle-protected).

**Required:** `folderId`

```json
{
  "data": {
    "username": "{{username}}",
    "folderId": "{{folderId}}",
    "newParentId": null
  }
}
```

**Returns:** `{ success }`.

### toggleFavorite

`POST /api/toggleFavorite` · **Signed in**

Star / unstar a file or folder.

**Required:** `resourceId`, `resourceType`

```json
{
  "data": {
    "username": "{{username}}",
    "resourceId": "{{folderId}}",
    "resourceType": "folder"
  }
}
```

**Returns:** `{ success, isFavorite }`.

### shareResource

`POST /api/shareResource` · **Signed in**

Share with users and/or set visibility (owner / admin role).

**Required:** `resourceId`, `resourceType`

```json
{
  "data": {
    "username": "{{username}}",
    "resourceId": "{{folderId}}",
    "resourceType": "folder",
    "visibility": "private",
    "permissions": {
      "{{targetUsername}}": "viewer"
    },
    "sharedWith": []
  }
}
```

**Returns:** `{ success }`.

**Notes:** `visibility`: `private` | `organization` | `public`. `permissions` maps username → `admin` | `editor` | `viewer`; `sharedWith` is the legacy viewer-only list.

### getResourceShares

`POST /api/getResourceShares` · **Signed in**

Who a resource is shared with (share dialog).

**Required:** `resourceId`, `resourceType`

```json
{
  "data": {
    "username": "{{username}}",
    "resourceId": "{{folderId}}",
    "resourceType": "folder"
  }
}
```

**Returns:** The share list with roles and visibility.

### createShareLink

`POST /api/createShareLink` · **Signed in**

Create or rotate a public share link.

**Required:** `resourceId`, `resourceType`

```json
{
  "data": {
    "username": "{{username}}",
    "resourceId": "{{folderId}}",
    "resourceType": "folder",
    "linkRole": "viewer"
  }
}
```

**Returns:** `{ token, role }` — the SPA link is `APP_PUBLIC_URL/share/<token>`.

### getSharedResource

`POST /api/getSharedResource` · **Public — no token**

Resolve a share-link token.

**Required:** `token`

```json
{
  "data": {
    "token": "{{shareToken}}"
  }
}
```

**Returns:** `{ resource, resourceType, role }`.

### revokeShareLink

`POST /api/revokeShareLink` · **Signed in**

Revoke a share link you created.

**Required:** `token`

```json
{
  "data": {
    "username": "{{username}}",
    "token": "{{shareToken}}"
  }
}
```

**Returns:** `{ success }`.

### getActivity

`POST /api/getActivity` · **Signed in**

Activity for a resource, the caller's recent activity, or Carpenter share attempts.

```json
{
  "data": {
    "username": "{{username}}",
    "resourceId": null,
    "limit": 50,
    "kind": null
  }
}
```

**Returns:** `{ activity: [...] }`.

**Notes:** `kind: "shareAttempts"` returns Carpenter share attempts (with client + follow-up date) instead of Drive activity.

### deleteFolder

`POST /api/deleteFolder` · **Signed in**

Delete a folder subtree; files move to Home unless deleteFiles.

**Required:** `folderId`

```json
{
  "data": {
    "username": "{{username}}",
    "folderId": "{{folderId}}",
    "deleteFiles": false
  }
}
```

**Returns:** `{ success, foldersDeleted }`.

## Catalog (collections & products)

The tile / laminate library: collections → products → faces (images). Uploading a product auto-publishes its public page and QR.

| Endpoint | Auth | Purpose |
|---|---|---|
| [`createCollection`](#createcollection) | Signed in | Create a tile or laminate collection. |
| [`listCollections`](#listcollections) | Signed in | Collections visible to the user (own + shared; org members see their manufacturer's). |
| [`updateCollection`](#updatecollection) | Signed in | Rename, describe or share a collection you own. |
| [`uploadProducts`](#uploadproducts) | Signed in | Bulk upload images into a collection (multipart/form-data). |
| [`listProducts`](#listproducts) | Signed in | Paginated products of a collection (cover thumbnails only). |
| [`getProduct`](#getproduct) | Signed in | One product with all of its faces. |
| [`getProductImages`](#getproductimages) | Signed in | Faces for several products at once. |
| [`renameProduct`](#renameproduct) | Signed in | Rename a product (unique within its collection). |
| [`deleteProduct`](#deleteproduct) | Signed in | Delete a product and its files (its public page stays online). |
| [`deleteCollection`](#deletecollection) | Signed in | Delete a collection, its products, faces and files. |

### createCollection

`POST /api/createCollection` · **Signed in**

Create a tile or laminate collection.

**Required:** `name`

```json
{
  "data": {
    "username": "{{username}}",
    "name": "Postman Laminates",
    "type": "laminate",
    "description": "Created from Postman",
    "isShared": false
  }
}
```

**Returns:** The collection (`id`, `name`, `type`, `owner`, `isShared`, `productCount`, …).

### listCollections

`POST /api/listCollections` · **Signed in**

Collections visible to the user (own + shared; org members see their manufacturer's).

```json
{
  "data": {
    "username": "{{username}}",
    "type": "laminate",
    "page": 1,
    "pageSize": 40,
    "search": ""
  }
}
```

**Returns:** `{ collections, total, page, pageSize, hasMore }`.

### updateCollection

`POST /api/updateCollection` · **Signed in**

Rename, describe or share a collection you own.

**Required:** `collectionId`

```json
{
  "data": {
    "username": "{{username}}",
    "collectionId": "{{collectionId}}",
    "name": "Postman Laminates (renamed)",
    "description": "Updated",
    "isShared": false
  }
}
```

**Returns:** The updated collection.

### uploadProducts

`POST /api/uploadProducts` · **Signed in**

Bulk upload images into a collection (multipart/form-data).

**Form fields** (`multipart/form-data`):

| Field | Example | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| `files` | *(file)* | One or more images (repeat the key). Pick files in Postman before sending. |
| `collectionId` | `{{collectionId}}` | Existing collection — or send collectionName instead. |
| `collectionName` | `—` | Name to create/reuse when collectionId is empty. |
| `type` | `laminate` | tile | laminate |
| `paths` | `[]` | JSON array of webkitRelativePath per file (folder uploads → one product per folder). |
| `autoPublish` | `1` | "0" skips creating each product's public page + QR. |
| `username` | `{{username}}` | Ignored when a Bearer token is sent. |

**Returns:** `{ success, collection, productsCreated, productsUpdated, facesStored, skipped, products, publications }`.

**Notes:** Limits: MAX_UPLOAD_MB per file (default 25), MAX_UPLOAD_FILES per request (default 200). Loose files sharing a base name with a trailing token (`oak_x.png`, `oak_y.png`) become one product with two faces. Re-uploading a name merges into the existing product.

### listProducts

`POST /api/listProducts` · **Signed in**

Paginated products of a collection (cover thumbnails only).

```json
{
  "data": {
    "username": "{{username}}",
    "collectionId": "{{collectionId}}",
    "type": "laminate",
    "page": 1,
    "pageSize": 40,
    "search": ""
  }
}
```

**Returns:** `{ products, total, page, pageSize, hasMore }`.

### getProduct

`POST /api/getProduct` · **Signed in**

One product with all of its faces.

**Required:** `productId`

```json
{
  "data": {
    "username": "{{username}}",
    "productId": "{{productId}}"
  }
}
```

**Returns:** `{ product: { …, images: [{ id, face, url, thumbUrl, … }] } }`.

**Notes:** An image `id` from here is what generation calls accept as `{ imageId }`.

### getProductImages

`POST /api/getProductImages` · **Signed in**

Faces for several products at once.

```json
{
  "data": {
    "username": "{{username}}",
    "productIds": [
      "{{productId}}"
    ]
  }
}
```

**Returns:** `{ products: [{ id, images }] }`.

### renameProduct

`POST /api/renameProduct` · **Signed in**

Rename a product (unique within its collection).

**Required:** `productId`, `name`

```json
{
  "data": {
    "username": "{{username}}",
    "productId": "{{productId}}",
    "name": "Natural Oak"
  }
}
```

**Returns:** The updated product.

### deleteProduct

`POST /api/deleteProduct` · **Signed in**

Delete a product and its files (its public page stays online).

**Required:** `productId`

```json
{
  "data": {
    "username": "{{username}}",
    "productId": "{{productId}}"
  }
}
```

**Returns:** `{ success }`.

### deleteCollection

`POST /api/deleteCollection` · **Signed in**

Delete a collection, its products, faces and files.

**Required:** `collectionId`

```json
{
  "data": {
    "username": "{{username}}",
    "collectionId": "{{collectionId}}"
  }
}
```

**Returns:** `{ success, productsDeleted }`.

## QR-Gen-Pro

Public product pages (`/product/<token>`), public collection pages (`/collection/<token>`) and dynamic QR codes (`/q/<code>`) that can be re-pointed at either without reprinting.

| Endpoint | Auth | Purpose |
|---|---|---|
| [`createProductPage`](#createproductpage) | Signed in | Publish a product's page (reuses its live page if it has one). |
| [`getProductPublications`](#getproductpublications) | Signed in | Pages + QRs for a batch of products. |
| [`publishProducts`](#publishproducts) | Signed in | Give each product a page + QR (idempotent). |
| [`getProductPage`](#getproductpage) | Public — no token | Resolve a product page (counts a view). |
| [`listProductPages`](#listproductpages) | Signed in | Your product pages. |
| [`updateProductPage`](#updateproductpage) | Signed in | Edit a page's details or disable it. |
| [`publishCollectionPage`](#publishcollectionpage) | Signed in | Public link + QR for a whole collection (idempotent). |
| [`getCollectionPage`](#getcollectionpage) | Public — no token | Resolve a collection page — every product, live. |
| [`updateCollectionPage`](#updatecollectionpage) | Signed in | Disable / re-enable a collection link. |
| [`createQrCode`](#createqrcode) | Signed in | Create 1–50 QR codes, optionally mapped to a page. |
| [`listQrCodes`](#listqrcodes) | Signed in | Your QR codes with their targets. |
| [`updateQrCode`](#updateqrcode) | Signed in | Re-label or re-map a QR (null targetToken = unmap). |
| [`resolveQrCode`](#resolveqrcode) | Public — no token | Where a scanned QR lands (counts a scan). |
| [`deleteQrCode`](#deleteqrcode) | Signed in | Delete a QR (printed copies stop working). |
| [`deleteProductPage`](#deleteproductpage) | Signed in | Delete a product page; QRs pointing at it become unmapped. |

### createProductPage

`POST /api/createProductPage` · **Signed in**

Publish a product's page (reuses its live page if it has one).

**Required:** `productId`

```json
{
  "data": {
    "username": "{{username}}",
    "productId": "{{productId}}",
    "title": "Natural Oak",
    "category": "Laminates",
    "size": "8x4 ft",
    "description": "1mm matte finish"
  }
}
```

**Returns:** Page summary (`token`, `url`, `name`, `category`, `size`, `coverUrl`, `views`, `revoked`, …) + `reused`.

### getProductPublications

`POST /api/getProductPublications` · **Signed in**

Pages + QRs for a batch of products.

```json
{
  "data": {
    "username": "{{username}}",
    "productIds": [
      "{{productId}}"
    ]
  }
}
```

**Returns:** `{ publications: [{ productId, page, qrCodes, pageCreated, qrCreated }] }`.

### publishProducts

`POST /api/publishProducts` · **Signed in**

Give each product a page + QR (idempotent).

```json
{
  "data": {
    "username": "{{username}}",
    "productIds": [
      "{{productId}}"
    ]
  }
}
```

**Returns:** `{ publications }`.

### getProductPage

`POST /api/getProductPage` · **Public — no token**

Resolve a product page (counts a view).

**Required:** `token`

```json
{
  "data": {
    "token": "{{productPageToken}}"
  }
}
```

**Returns:** The page snapshot: `name`, `type`, `category`, `size`, `collectionName`, `description`, `images`, `owner`, `views`, …

### listProductPages

`POST /api/listProductPages` · **Signed in**

Your product pages.

```json
{
  "data": {
    "username": "{{username}}",
    "page": 1,
    "pageSize": 40,
    "search": ""
  }
}
```

**Returns:** `{ pages, total, hasMore }`.

### updateProductPage

`POST /api/updateProductPage` · **Signed in**

Edit a page's details or disable it.

**Required:** `token`

```json
{
  "data": {
    "username": "{{username}}",
    "token": "{{productPageToken}}",
    "category": "Premium laminates",
    "size": "8x4 ft",
    "description": "Updated from Postman",
    "revoked": false
  }
}
```

**Returns:** Page summary.

### publishCollectionPage

`POST /api/publishCollectionPage` · **Signed in**

Public link + QR for a whole collection (idempotent).

**Required:** `collectionId`

```json
{
  "data": {
    "username": "{{username}}",
    "collectionId": "{{collectionId}}"
  }
}
```

**Returns:** `{ token, url, collectionId, name, views, revoked, reused, qrCodes }`.

**Notes:** Also publishes any product in the collection that has no page yet.

### getCollectionPage

`POST /api/getCollectionPage` · **Public — no token**

Resolve a collection page — every product, live.

**Required:** `token`

```json
{
  "data": {
    "token": "{{collectionPageToken}}"
  }
}
```

**Returns:** `{ token, name, type, description, owner, views, productCount, products: [{ id, token, name, category, size, images, … }] }`.

### updateCollectionPage

`POST /api/updateCollectionPage` · **Signed in**

Disable / re-enable a collection link.

**Required:** `token`

```json
{
  "data": {
    "username": "{{username}}",
    "token": "{{collectionPageToken}}",
    "revoked": false
  }
}
```

**Returns:** Collection page summary.

### createQrCode

`POST /api/createQrCode` · **Signed in**

Create 1–50 QR codes, optionally mapped to a page.

```json
{
  "data": {
    "username": "{{username}}",
    "label": "Showroom rack 3",
    "count": 1,
    "targetToken": "{{productPageToken}}",
    "targetType": "product"
  }
}
```

**Returns:** `{ qrCodes: [{ id, code, url, label, targetToken, targetType, target, collectionTarget, scans, … }] }`.

**Notes:** `targetType`: `product` (default) | `collection` — with `collection`, `targetToken` is a collection page token.

### listQrCodes

`POST /api/listQrCodes` · **Signed in**

Your QR codes with their targets.

```json
{
  "data": {
    "username": "{{username}}",
    "page": 1,
    "pageSize": 60,
    "search": ""
  }
}
```

**Returns:** `{ qrCodes, total, hasMore }`.

### updateQrCode

`POST /api/updateQrCode` · **Signed in**

Re-label or re-map a QR (null targetToken = unmap).

**Required:** `id`

```json
{
  "data": {
    "username": "{{username}}",
    "id": "{{qrId}}",
    "label": "Showroom rack 3",
    "targetToken": "{{collectionPageToken}}",
    "targetType": "collection"
  }
}
```

**Returns:** The QR record.

### resolveQrCode

`POST /api/resolveQrCode` · **Public — no token**

Where a scanned QR lands (counts a scan).

**Required:** `code`

```json
{
  "data": {
    "code": "{{qrCode}}"
  }
}
```

**Returns:** `{ code, mapped, url, token? }` — `url` is null while unmapped.

### deleteQrCode

`POST /api/deleteQrCode` · **Signed in**

Delete a QR (printed copies stop working).

**Required:** `id`

```json
{
  "data": {
    "username": "{{username}}",
    "id": "{{qrId}}"
  }
}
```

**Returns:** `{ success }`.

### deleteProductPage

`POST /api/deleteProductPage` · **Signed in**

Delete a product page; QRs pointing at it become unmapped.

**Required:** `token`

```json
{
  "data": {
    "username": "{{username}}",
    "token": "{{productPageToken}}"
  }
}
```

**Returns:** `{ success }`.

### createProductLink

### getProductLink

`POST /api/getProductLink` · **Public — no token**

Resolve a render link (counts a view).

```json
{
  "data": {
    "token": "{{productLinkToken}}"
  }
}
```

`POST /api/listProductLinks` · **Signed in**

Your render links.

```json
{
```

## Carpenter sharing

Share attempts, clients and follow-ups for the Carpenter Pro flow. Counts are attempts, never confirmed deliveries.

| Endpoint | Auth | Purpose |
|---|---|---|
| [`recordShareAttempt`](#recordshareattempt) | Signed in | Log a share attempt and create / update the client. |
| [`updateShareAttempt`](#updateshareattempt) | Signed in | Mark your attempt sent / failed / cancelled (or back to attempted). |
| [`getShareStats`](#getsharestats) | Signed in | Sharing stats for Home (manufacturers include sponsored dealers). |
| [`listFollowUps`](#listfollowups) | Signed in | Clients with a follow-up date, bucketed overdue / today / upcoming. |
| [`listShareClients`](#listshareclients) | Signed in | Clients visible to the user. |
| [`updateShareClient`](#updateshareclient) | Signed in | Edit your client (null followUpDate clears it). |

### recordShareAttempt

`POST /api/recordShareAttempt` · **Signed in**

Log a share attempt and create / update the client.

**Required:** `clientName or clientId`

```json
{
  "data": {
    "username": "{{username}}",
    "clientName": "Priya Shah",
    "whatsapp": "+919876543210",
    "notes": "Natural Oak · Kitchen",
    "followUpDate": "2026-10-05",
    "generationId": "{{generationId}}",
    "channel": "device_share",
    "status": "attempted",
    "outgoingMessage": "Here is your render"
  }
}
```

**Returns:** `{ success, attemptId, attempt, client, countedAs: "attempt" }`.

**Notes:** `channel`: `device_share` | `copy`. `status` on create: `attempted` | `cancelled`. Refused for roles without share capability.

### updateShareAttempt

`POST /api/updateShareAttempt` · **Signed in**

Mark your attempt sent / failed / cancelled (or back to attempted).

**Required:** `attemptId`, `status`

```json
{
  "data": {
    "username": "{{username}}",
    "attemptId": "{{attemptId}}",
    "status": "sent",
    "statusNote": "Client replied"
  }
}
```

**Returns:** `{ success, attempt }`.

### getShareStats

`POST /api/getShareStats` · **Signed in**

Sharing stats for Home (manufacturers include sponsored dealers).

```json
{
  "data": {
    "username": "{{username}}"
  }
}
```

**Returns:** `{ total, last7Days, last30Days, uniqueClients, byStatus, byChannel, followUps: { overdue, dueToday, upcoming, horizonDays } }`.

### listFollowUps

`POST /api/listFollowUps` · **Signed in**

Clients with a follow-up date, bucketed overdue / today / upcoming.

```json
{
  "data": {
    "username": "{{username}}",
    "days": 14,
    "limit": 100
  }
}
```

**Returns:** `{ today, horizon, items: [{ bucket, client, canEdit, attemptCount, lastAttemptAt }] }`.

### listShareClients

`POST /api/listShareClients` · **Signed in**

Clients visible to the user.

```json
{
  "data": {
    "username": "{{username}}",
    "limit": 100
  }
}
```

**Returns:** `{ clients }`.

### updateShareClient

`POST /api/updateShareClient` · **Signed in**

Edit your client (null followUpDate clears it).

**Required:** `clientId`

```json
{
  "data": {
    "username": "{{username}}",
    "clientId": "{{clientId}}",
```

## Carpenter scenes

Real room photos Carpenter Pro renders a laminate onto (`generateCarpenter` with `sceneId`). Bulk-loaded with `npm run scenes:import -- <folder>` (see setup-production.md); curated in Admin Panel → Carpenter Scenes. Hidden scenes are never offered to users or accepted for generation.

| Endpoint | Auth | Purpose |
|---|---|---|
| [`listCarpenterScenes`](#listcarpenterscenes) | Signed in | Visible scenes, grouped by category (admins can include hidden ones). |
| [`createCarpenterScene`](#createcarpenterscene) | admin only | Upload one scene. |
| [`updateCarpenterScene`](#updatecarpenterscene) | admin only | Rename, recategorize, change ratio, reorder, show / hide. |
| [`setCarpenterScenesActive`](#setcarpenterscenesactive) | admin only | Show or hide many scenes at once. |
| [`deleteCarpenterScene`](#deletecarpenterscene) | admin only | Delete a scene and its image files. |

### listCarpenterScenes

`POST /api/listCarpenterScenes` · **Signed in**

Visible scenes, grouped by category (admins can include hidden ones).

```json
{
  "data": {
    "username": "{{username}}",
    "category": null,
    "includeHidden": false
  }
}
```

**Returns:** `{ categories: [{ id, label, count }], ratios, scenes: [{ id, name, category, categoryLabel, aspectRatio, imageUrl, thumbUrl, width, height }] }` — with `includeHidden` (admin only) each scene also has `active`, `hiddenReason`, `sortOrder`.

### createCarpenterScene

`POST /api/createCarpenterScene` · **admin only**

Upload one scene.

**Required:** `imageBase64`, `category`

```json
{
  "data": {
    "username": "{{username}}",
    "imageBase64": "{{sampleImageBase64}}",
    "imageMimeType": "image/png",
    "category": "kitchen",
    "name": "Postman kitchen",
    "aspectRatio": null
  }
}
```

**Returns:** `{ scene, warning }` — `warning` is set ("low resolution" / "mostly blank") when the importer would have hidden it; the scene is visible either way.

**Notes:** Stored as WebP (longest edge 2048) with a thumbnail. `aspectRatio` defaults to the nearest of 1:1, 3:4, 4:3, 9:16, 16:9; `name` defaults to "<Category> <n>". A new category slug is created on the fly.

### updateCarpenterScene

`POST /api/updateCarpenterScene` · **admin only**

Rename, recategorize, change ratio, reorder, show / hide.

**Required:** `sceneId`

```json
{
  "data": {
    "username": "{{username}}",
    "sceneId": "{{sceneId}}",
    "name": "Kitchen — island",
    "category": "kitchen",
    "aspectRatio": "4:3",
    "active": true,
    "sortOrder": 0
  }
}
```

**Returns:** `{ scene }` (admin fields included).

### setCarpenterScenesActive

`POST /api/setCarpenterScenesActive` · **admin only**

Show or hide many scenes at once.

**Required:** `sceneIds`

```json
{
  "data": {
    "username": "{{username}}",
    "sceneIds": [
      "{{sceneId}}"
    ],
    "active": true
  }
}
```

**Returns:** `{ success, updated }`.

### deleteCarpenterScene

`POST /api/deleteCarpenterScene` · **admin only**

Delete a scene and its image files.

**Required:** `sceneId`

```json
{
  "data": {
    "username": "{{username}}",
    "sceneId": "{{sceneId}}"
  }
}
```

**Returns:** `{ success }` — past renders keep their own copies.

### saveTileCollection

`POST /api/saveTileCollection` · **admin · bootlegar**

Save a scene with its surfaces.

```json
{
  "data": {
    "username": "{{username}}",

    "sceneMimeType": "image/png",

      {
        "id": "floor-1",
        "label": "Floor",
        "plane": "floor",
        "tileSize": "600x600",
        "tileImageIds": [],
        "corners": [
          {
            "x": 0.1,
            "y": 0.6
          },
          {
            "x": 0.9,
            "y": 0.6
          },
          {
            "x": 1,
            "y": 1
          },
          {
            "x": 0,
            "y": 1
          }
        ],
        "repeatX": 8,
        "repeatY": 6,
        "rotation": 0,
        "opacity": 1,
        "tileScale": 1
      }
    ]
  }
}
```

**Returns:** `{ success, collectionId, sceneImageUrl }`.

### listTileCollections

`POST /api/listTileCollections` · **Public — no token**

All scenes.

```json
{
  "data": {}
}
```

**Returns:** `{ success, collections }` (newest 60).

### getCollectionScene

`POST /api/getCollectionScene` · **Public — no token**

A scene image as base64 (for canvas compositing).

**Required:** `collectionId`

```json
{
  "data": {
    "collectionId": "{{tileCollectionId}}"
  }
}
```

**Returns:** `{ success, base64, mimeType }`.

### deleteTileCollection

`POST /api/deleteTileCollection` · **admin · bootlegar**

Delete a scene.

**Required:** `collectionId`

```json
{
  "data": {
    "username": "{{username}}",
    "collectionId": "{{tileCollectionId}}"
  }
}
```

**Returns:** `{ success }`.

## Tile sizes

The size list TileMaster offers (built-ins + admin-added).

| Endpoint | Auth | Purpose |
|---|---|---|
| [`getTileSizes`](#gettilesizes) | Public — no token | Custom sizes and hidden built-in markers. |
| [`createTileSize`](#createtilesize) | admin only | Add a custom size. |
| [`deleteTileSize`](#deletetilesize) | admin only | Remove a custom size, or hide a built-in. |
| [`restoreTileSize`](#restoretilesize) | admin only | Un-hide a built-in size. |

### getTileSizes

`POST /api/getTileSizes` · **Public — no token**

Custom sizes and hidden built-in markers.

```json
{
  "data": {}
}
```

**Returns:** Array of size records.

### createTileSize

`POST /api/createTileSize` · **admin only**

Add a custom size.

**Required:** `width`, `height`, `unit`

```json
{
  "data": {
    "callerUsername": "{{username}}",
    "width": 600,
    "height": 1200,
    "unit": "mm",
    "cat": "Floor"
  }
}
```

**Returns:** The size record (`id` = its value, e.g. `600x1200`).

### deleteTileSize

`POST /api/deleteTileSize` · **admin only**

Remove a custom size, or hide a built-in.

**Required:** `value`

```json
{
  "data": {
    "callerUsername": "{{username}}",
    "value": "{{tileSizeValue}}",
    "isBuiltIn": false
  }
}
```

**Returns:** `{ success }`.

### restoreTileSize

`POST /api/restoreTileSize` · **admin only**

Un-hide a built-in size.

**Required:** `value`

```json
{
  "data": {
    "callerUsername": "{{username}}",
    "value": "600x600"
  }
}
```

**Returns:** `{ success }`.

## Master prompts

Admin-managed prompt templates per tool; one is active per tool.

| Endpoint | Auth | Purpose |
|---|---|---|
| [`createMasterPrompt`](#createmasterprompt) | admin only | Add a prompt template. |
| [`getMasterPrompts`](#getmasterprompts) | Public — no token | Prompts for a tool, newest first. |
| [`updateMasterPrompt`](#updatemasterprompt) | admin only | Edit a prompt. |
| [`setActiveMasterPrompt`](#setactivemasterprompt) | admin only | Make a prompt the active one for its tool. |
| [`deleteMasterPrompt`](#deletemasterprompt) | admin only | Delete a prompt. |

### createMasterPrompt

`POST /api/createMasterPrompt` · **admin only**

Add a prompt template.

**Required:** `name`, `tool`, `template`

```json
{
  "data": {
    "callerUsername": "{{username}}",
    "name": "Postman prompt",
    "tool": "CARPENTER",
    "template": "Photorealistic interior, soft daylight"
  }
}
```

**Returns:** The prompt record.

### getMasterPrompts

`POST /api/getMasterPrompts` · **Public — no token**

Prompts for a tool, newest first.

**Required:** `tool`

```json
{
  "data": {
    "tool": "CARPENTER"
  }
}
```

**Returns:** Array of prompt records.

### updateMasterPrompt

`POST /api/updateMasterPrompt` · **admin only**

Edit a prompt.

**Required:** `id`, `updates`

```json
{
  "data": {
    "callerUsername": "{{username}}",
    "id": "{{promptId}}",
    "updates": {
      "name": "Postman prompt (edited)",
      "template": "Photorealistic interior, warm evening light"
    }
  }
}
```

**Returns:** `{ success }`.

### setActiveMasterPrompt

`POST /api/setActiveMasterPrompt` · **admin only**

Make a prompt the active one for its tool.

**Required:** `id`

```json
{
  "data": {
    "callerUsername": "{{username}}",
    "id": "{{promptId}}"
  }
}
```

**Returns:** `{ success }`.

### deleteMasterPrompt

`POST /api/deleteMasterPrompt` · **admin only**

Delete a prompt.

**Required:** `id`

```json
{
  "data": {
    "callerUsername": "{{username}}",
    "id": "{{promptId}}"
  }
}
```

**Returns:** `{ success }`.

## Shop & payments

Credit packages and Razorpay checkout.

| Endpoint | Auth | Purpose |
|---|---|---|
| [`getPackages`](#getpackages) | Public — no token | Credit packages (cached briefly). |
| [`createPackage`](#createpackage) | admin only | Add a credit package. |
| [`updatePackage`](#updatepackage) | admin only | Edit a package. |
| [`createPaymentOrder`](#createpaymentorder) | Signed in | Create a Razorpay order for a package. |
| [`verifyPaymentSignature`](#verifypaymentsignature) | Signed in | Verify Razorpay's signature and credit the account (idempotent). |
| [`deletePackage`](#deletepackage) | admin only | Delete a package. |

### getPackages

`POST /api/getPackages` · **Public — no token**

Credit packages (cached briefly).

```json
{
  "data": {}
}
```

**Returns:** Array of packages.

### createPackage

`POST /api/createPackage` · **admin only**

Add a credit package.

**Required:** `credits`, `price`

```json
{
  "data": {
    "callerUsername": "{{username}}",
    "credits": 100,
    "price": 2500,
    "tagline": "Postman pack",
    "color": "#111111",
    "isPopular": false
  }
}
```

**Returns:** The package.

### updatePackage

`POST /api/updatePackage` · **admin only**

Edit a package.

**Required:** `packageId`, `updates`

```json
{
  "data": {
    "callerUsername": "{{username}}",
    "packageId": "{{packageId}}",
    "updates": {
      "price": 2400,
      "tagline": "Postman pack (sale)"
    }
  }
}
```

**Returns:** `{ success }`.

**Notes:** Allowed keys: `credits`, `price`, `isPopular`, `color`, `tagline`.

### createPaymentOrder

`POST /api/createPaymentOrder` · **Signed in**

Create a Razorpay order for a package.

**Required:** `packageId`

```json
{
  "data": {
    "username": "{{username}}",
    "packageId": "{{packageId}}"
  }
}
```

**Returns:** `{ orderId, amount, currency, keyId, credits }`.

**Notes:** Needs RAZORPAY_KEY_ID / RAZORPAY_KEY_SECRET.

### verifyPaymentSignature

`POST /api/verifyPaymentSignature` · **Signed in**

Verify Razorpay's signature and credit the account (idempotent).

**Required:** `razorpay_order_id`, `razorpay_payment_id`, `razorpay_signature`

```json
{
  "data": {
    "username": "{{username}}",
    "packageId": "{{packageId}}",
    "credits": 100,
    "razorpay_order_id": "order_xxx",
    "razorpay_payment_id": "pay_xxx",
    "razorpay_signature": "<from Razorpay checkout>"
  }
}
```

**Returns:** `{ success, message }` — a repeated payment id is a no-op.

### deletePackage

`POST /api/deletePackage` · **admin only**

Delete a package.

**Required:** `packageId`

```json
{
  "data": {
    "callerUsername": "{{username}}",
    "packageId": "{{packageId}}"
  }
}
```

**Returns:** `{ success }`.

## Org chat

One chat room per organization (organization + its members). The room id is the organization's username: a member's `organizationId`, or an organization account's own username; admins may open any room. In Postman, `login` fills `{{organizationId}}` accordingly when it is empty.

| Endpoint | Auth | Purpose |
|---|---|---|
| [`getChatMessages`](#getchatmessages) | Signed in | Messages after a cursor (tail of the room when omitted). |
| [`sendChatMessage`](#sendchatmessage) | Signed in | Post a text message. |
| [`sendChatFile`](#sendchatfile) | Signed in | Attach a file (base64). |
| [`setChatTyping`](#setchattyping) | Signed in | Typing indicator on / off. |

### getChatMessages

`POST /api/getChatMessages` · **Signed in**

Messages after a cursor (tail of the room when omitted).

**Required:** `organizationId`

```json
{
  "data": {
    "username": "{{username}}",
    "organizationId": "{{organizationId}}",
    "afterId": null,
    "limit": 50
  }
}
```

**Returns:** `{ messages, typing, cursor }`.

### sendChatMessage

`POST /api/sendChatMessage` · **Signed in**

Post a text message.

**Required:** `organizationId`, `text`

```json
{
  "data": {
    "username": "{{username}}",
    "organizationId": "{{organizationId}}",
    "text": "Hello from Postman"
  }
}
```

**Returns:** `{ success, message }`.

### sendChatFile

`POST /api/sendChatFile` · **Signed in**

Attach a file (base64).

```json
{
  "data": {
    "username": "{{username}}",
    "organizationId": "{{organizationId}}",
    "base64": "{{sampleImageBase64}}",
    "fileName": "pixel.png",
    "fileType": "image/png"
  }
}
```

**Returns:** `{ success, message }`.

### setChatTyping

`POST /api/setChatTyping` · **Signed in**

Typing indicator on / off.

**Required:** `organizationId`

```json
{
  "data": {
    "username": "{{username}}",
    "organizationId": "{{organizationId}}",
    "typing": true
  }
}
```

**Returns:** `{ success }`.

## System (admin)

Image-provider configuration from the Admin Panel. Keys saved here are stored in the database; keys in .env take precedence.

| Endpoint | Auth | Purpose |
|---|---|---|
| [`getSystemStatus`](#getsystemstatus) | admin only | Live provider, key presence and masked previews. |
| [`setGeminiKey`](#setgeminikey) | admin only | Save the Gemini API key. |
| [`setOpenAIKey`](#setopenaikey) | admin only | Save the OpenAI API key. |
| [`setImageProvider`](#setimageprovider) | admin only | Switch generations between Gemini and OpenAI. |

### getSystemStatus

`POST /api/getSystemStatus` · **admin only**

Live provider, key presence and masked previews.

```json
{
  "data": {
    "username": "{{username}}"
  }
}
```

**Returns:** Provider + per-key status.

### setGeminiKey

`POST /api/setGeminiKey` · **admin only**

Save the Gemini API key.

**Required:** `apiKey`

```json
{
  "data": {
    "username": "{{username}}",
    "apiKey": "<gemini api key>"
  }
}
```

**Returns:** `{ success }`.

### setOpenAIKey

`POST /api/setOpenAIKey` · **admin only**

Save the OpenAI API key.

**Required:** `apiKey`

```json
{
  "data": {
    "username": "{{username}}",
    "apiKey": "<openai api key>"
  }
}
```

**Returns:** `{ success }`.

### setImageProvider

`POST /api/setImageProvider` · **admin only**

Switch generations between Gemini and OpenAI.

**Required:** `provider`

```json
{
  "data": {
    "username": "{{username}}",
    "provider": "gemini"
  }
}
```

**Returns:** `{ success, provider }`.

**Notes:** Refused while the target provider has no key.

## Error log

Client + server error capture, viewed in the Admin Panel.

| Endpoint | Auth | Purpose |
|---|---|---|
| [`logClientError`](#logclienterror) | Public — no token | Report a client-side failure. |
| [`getErrorLogs`](#geterrorlogs) | admin · bootlegar · organization | Recent errors, newest first. |
| [`resolveErrorLog`](#resolveerrorlog) | admin · bootlegar · organization | Mark an entry resolved / unresolved. |
| [`clearErrorLogs`](#clearerrorlogs) | admin · bootlegar · organization | Clear the log (optionally only resolved entries). |

### logClientError

`POST /api/logClientError` · **Public — no token**

Report a client-side failure.

```json
{
  "data": {
    "username": "{{username}}",
    "tool": "CARPENTER",
    "code": "unavailable",
    "message": "Couldn't reach the server",
    "detail": "",
    "url": "https://namelessos.cloud/",
    "userAgent": "Postman"
  }
}
```

**Returns:** `{ success }`.

### getErrorLogs

`POST /api/getErrorLogs` · **admin · bootlegar · organization**

Recent errors, newest first.

```json
{
  "data": {
    "username": "{{username}}",
    "limit": 100
  }
}
```

**Returns:** `{ success, logs }`.

### resolveErrorLog

`POST /api/resolveErrorLog` · **admin · bootlegar · organization**

Mark an entry resolved / unresolved.

**Required:** `id`

```json
{
  "data": {
    "username": "{{username}}",
    "id": "{{errorLogId}}",
    "resolved": true
  }
}
```

**Returns:** `{ success }`.

### clearErrorLogs

`POST /api/clearErrorLogs` · **admin · bootlegar · organization**

Clear the log (optionally only resolved entries).

```json
{
  "data": {
    "username": "{{username}}",
    "resolvedOnly": true
  }
}
```

**Returns:** `{ success, deleted }`.
